ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: there are two reaction components in the figure, separated in the middle by “+”, and curved arrows are drawn; according to the problem statement, ignore the arrows. The upper component is labeled MeO2C on the left, connected to an alkyne segment, and connected on the right to an ester carbonyl C(=O)OCH3. The lower component contains a sulfur atom S bearing a negative sign, connected to a carbon chain, then connected to an ester group C(=O)OMe. Then reason: count only bonds between non-hydrogen atoms, and count single bonds, double bonds, and triple bonds each as one bond connection. The upper molecule is counted according to the specified method: on the left ester side there are Me–O, O–C(=O), C=O, C–alkyne, totaling 4; the alkyne bond C≡C is 1; on the right ester side there are alkyne–C(=O), C=O, C–O, O–CH3, totaling 4. Therefore the upper part has 4+1+4=9 heavy-atom bonds. The lower molecule has S–C, C–C(=O), C=O, C–O, O–Me, totaling 5 heavy-atom bonds. The total is 9+5=14.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: First count the top molecule only: left ester side contributes Me–O, O–C(=O), C=O, and C–alkyne; the alkyne contributes C≡C; the right ester side contributes alkyne–C(=O), C=O, C–O, and O–CH3, for 9 heavy-atom bonds. Then count the bottom molecule: S–C, C–C(=O), C=O, C–O, and O–Me, for 5 heavy-atom bonds. Add both components: 9 + 5 = 14.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中有两个反应组分，中间用“+”分隔，并画有弯箭头；按题意忽略箭头。上方组分左侧标为 MeO2C，连接到一段炔键，右侧连接到酯羰基 C(=O)OCH3。下方组分含有带负号的硫原子 S，连接到碳链，再连接到酯基 C(=O)OMe。再推理：只数非氢原子之间的键，并把单键、双键、三键各按一个键连接来计数。上方分子按指定方法计数：左酯侧有 Me–O、O–C(=O)、C=O、C–alkyne 共4个；炔键 C≡C 为1个；右酯侧有 alkyne–C(=O)、C=O、C–O、O–CH3 共4个。所以上方共 4+1+4=9 个重原子键。下方分子有 S–C、C–C(=O)、C=O、C–O、O–Me 共5个重原子键。总数为 9+5=14。
